answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to an attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, verified through signed remote attestation and a trusted key-registration policy. A copied virtual machine cannot reproduce the authorized measurement together with hardware-backed sealing keys; creating another valid identity therefore requires provisioning distinct physical silicon and enclave state, rather than duplicating software. Whether named comet, haven, or nadir, every node faces the same acquisition cost.
